spans.text: Arrived at the recon outpost where NZ-75 is located.
Hmm? Where's NZ?
Doesn't seem to be here. What should we do?
It's fine. I know what to do...
Hey, NZ! Your new dress is here! This one has the print of...
Clang!
Oh, so you were up there the whole time...
S-S-Screw you!
I didn't buy any new dress whatsoever!
Whatever. It can't be any more tasteless than the one you got last week anyway...
Hurry up and give the chief your report!
Jeez...
Report as follows: many Sangvis bases lie ahead, but security level is relatively low. Shouldn't be too big a problem as long as we're careful.
Where can we resupply?
I mean somewhere with proper food, not energy bars or chocolate.
Oh, about that...
Sorry to tell you...but all the supply outposts along the route are either destroyed or looted after the security system went down...
W-What?!
Dammit! I knew I should've ignored the arrangement and swapped with you!
It'd have been the same no matter who had this job. Besides, my stomach is also growling here...
Then there's nothing we can do.
Let's dig in on the emergency canned food and move the stuff quickly.
The locals there will surely show us some great hospitality...
Humph. They're counting on relief supplies. Don't expect them to cook us anything decent.
I say we pop the crates open and keep some stuff for ourselves. No one's gonna find out.
No, these goods are to be transported on the military's order. We must not touch them!
You're known for being honest, 56! How could you even suggest such a thing?!
So what if I'm honest?! Doesn't mean I'll take this crap!
No one can fight on an empty stomach!
To be honest, while I'm not as passionate about food as 56...
I also find it hard to keep up my spirits with just a few ration cans when there's nowhere to resupply...
We are technically authorized to borrow resources from humans to maintain our operational efficiency, right?
That's true...but please hang in there for just a little longer.
We're not far from our destination. Let's travel farther ahead. We're bound to come across a supply outpost that's intact at some point...I hope...
I almost thought you were gonna say we're bound to come across an oasis...
Just listen to the chief, NZ. We're under orders, after all.
We must stay united and work together, and bear with any difficulties we encounter, got it?
Tsk. Then hurry up already. Let's get this over with ASAP.
